title: Don't record a complete=false output-size band crossing for a single-frame body that ends in the same poll
outcome: Don't record a complete=false output-size band crossing for a single-frame body that ends in the same poll
acceptance: A single-frame response body of 16 MiB or more records only its complete observation, not an extra complete=false band-crossing observation, so it no longer appears in the incomplete slot
A deterministic test covers a large single-frame body and a genuinely truncated multi-frame body
